supplemental_observation_contracts.scope: Every actual route input, scope, prompt identity, class, live cancellation token; every evidence-bearing completion with correlated generated request ID, accepted result, exact provider model, terminal reason and emitted tool ownership. All 18 requests complete and no request_error occurs.
api_adaptations: Rust RouteOptions absent prompt_id is an empty String. This is compared explicitly and both real HTTP prompt headers remain absent in headerless variants.

The original JS callback executes evidence-bearing complete then no-op complete(id,undefined); native consumes its successful request lease once. Source records all 36 calls, native all 18 calls. Every source cleanup is checked false and every evidence-bearing call has exact semantic parity. No raw-call cardinality equivalence is claimed.

The frozen report retains explicit undefined sentinels in route-tuple fields, whereas the original deepEqual expected tuple has the property with undefined. Native tuple lacks the unrepresentable field; a null value is not dropped and would fail.

projection_scope: Frozen stability projection is limited to validated nonnegative latency, actual generated request UUIDs, automatic HTTP dates and registered loopback authorities, with an exact per-value ledger. Native raw reports are never projected or rewritten.
limits: Synthetic loopback HTTP with original supplied Jev responses; no real Claude, Jev or Ollama usage.

Complete semantic request-object assertions do not claim general JSON key-order parity beyond the original scope. Complete provider response bytes are compared exactly, including split UTF-8 and CRLF.
Per-variant original assertions all pass; no general socket fragmentation or wall-clock timing equivalence is claimed.
Native successful completion has one typed call per request, unlike the source extra no-op undefined cleanup callback. Native raw transcripts retain actual shapes.

independent_review.scope: Original callbacks/predicates, all38 exact source anchors/hashes, per-variant counts, actual native transcripts and documented supplemental typed API adaptations.
